items.name: AnimationMixer.update
items.note: Algorithm mapping for the explicit owned rig API only: finite TRS/normal-blend/repeat/once pipeline and prepared palettes. The ordinary public Three.js method remains JS; this is not full method compatibility.

items.name: Object3D.updateMatrix
items.note: C2 opt-in facade only: indexed f64 evaluation with tracked inputs, persistent evaluated matrices and selective stable snapshots. Overrides and replaced arrays use JS fallback. Ordinary animation and renderer remain JS.

items.name: Object3D.updateMatrixWorld
items.note: Legacy route scans JS state and eagerly copies matrices. C2 opt-in facade retains evaluated matrices in Rust, uploads dirty inputs and materializes observed snapshots. Both retain scoped fallback; public inputs and topology remain JS-owned.

items.name: Object3D.matrix
items.note: C2 opt-in facade only: Rust retains the evaluated local matrix; public proxy arrays are demand-driven snapshots. User matrix/TRS edits are pending JS inputs and caller-owned replacement arrays fall back. This is derived-state authority, not whole-scene ownership.

items.name: Object3D.matrixWorld
items.note: Explicit owned rigs retain logical world matrices. C2 also retains evaluated world matrices for eligible facade objects, with stable selective snapshots and JS mutation/override fallback. The default legacy bridge still has authoritative JS properties.
